_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your keys. config.json is gitignored and must never be committed.
_models_note: MODEL writes, reviews and judges; MODEL_FAST does extraction. Any Claude model (claude-...) or OpenAI model (gpt-...). Per 1M tokens in/out: claude-opus-5-5 $4/$20, claude-sonnet-5-5 $2/$10, claude-haiku-5-5 $0.10/$0.50, gpt-6.1-sol $2/$10, gpt-6-luna $0.10/$0.50. Leave MODEL out to use the default for the key you have. Run tools/benchmark.py to compare on your own resumes.
_workspace_note: Only for organisation-level Anthropic keys (error: 'not scoped to a workspace'). Find it under Settings > Workspaces.
_openai_note: Optional. Needed for OpenAI models and for voice answers in the Interview tab (speech-to-text).
_smtp_note: SMTP is OPTIONAL. Only needed for the Job Alerts email feature. Leave blank to disable. For Gmail use an App Password, not your account password.
